say:2:1230123001:1.text: They call themselves Water Wights, but they are actually just a bunch of dock workers hanging together.
say:2:1230123001:1.source_cn: 说是水鬼帮，其实就是一群聚在一起的码头工人。

say:3:1230123002:1.text: Those scoundrels only bully the weak but fear the strong. I remember they have been ousted by the Carmine Whispers from Rustport.
say:3:1230123002:1.source_cn: 那群只会欺软怕硬的家伙，我记得他们已经被血薇帮赶出锈锚港了。

say:4:1230123003:1.text: But they allied themselves with the Dead Tide Fleet afterward!
say:4:1230123003:1.source_cn: 是被赶走了，但水鬼帮竟然又投靠了死潮舰队！

say:5:1230123004:1.text: Carmine Whispers should have no mercy on those stealing scums.
say:5:1230123004:1.source_cn: 对待那群只知道掠夺的渣滓，血薇帮就不该仁慈。
